mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_fiscal_calendar (id, entity_type, entity_id, calendar_code, timezone, year_start_month, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{calendarCode}, #{timezone}, #{yearStartMonth}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, entity_type, entity_id, calendar_code, timezone, year_start_month, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_fiscal_calendar WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, entity_type, entity_id, calendar_code, timezone, year_start_month, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_fiscal_calendar WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, entity_type, entity_id, calendar_code, timezone, year_start_month, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_fiscal_calendar WHERE entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId}
